item_description_text:
A lego set is a building blocks toy box that can be assembled to make all sorts of different characters and things. Each lego set consists of small plastic bricks or other shapes that can be put together to make many different items. Lego sets usually come with instructions for how to make the bricks into specific things, like buildings and status. However, you can use Legos to make anything you can imagine, since the bricks can be used however you want.
